The fetch POLICY of every feed is a row of libs/data/terms_fence.SOURCE_POLICY (`feed_policy`): restricted-reuse feeds (BOJ, BOE, SNB, IMF, UN_NEWS, SP_INDICES) are IDEAS_ONLY and still fetched; unread ones (OPEC, USTR, TREASURY_OFAC, US_TREASURY, IMO_SHIPPING) are PUBLIC_PAGE.
